name: fix127_creature_effects
verifies: fix-127 creature hit effects as in CP 1.75 (species fist table 0x1000b200): a bloodfly's (hornet's) sting poisons the hero on every hit (30 s, -5 HP/s), the antidote It_Potion_CurePoison is drunk and cures it (PS_MagicPotion), Perk_ImmuneToPoison keeps him clean; a ripper's bite infects him (SP bar grey) and It_Potion_CureDisease cures it; a fire varan's bite sets him on fire once the blow leaves him under 100 HP
steps: spawn Bloodfly attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=b
spawn Bloodfly attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=b2
spawn Ripper attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=r
spawn FireWaran attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=v
notes: Not run (no editor in fix-127). G3: creatures hold the species Fist; Bloodfly/SwampLurker/ScorpionKing fists carry quality 4 (poison), Zombie/Ripper/Varan/Troll 2 (disease), FireVaran/FireGolem 8 (burning, only when the blow leaves the victim under 100 HP), IceGolem 16 (frost, under 50 HP). The poison bar colour (HP teal) and the disease colour (SP grey) show on the HUD; there is no message. `hp hero 90` before the fire varan so its bite leaves him under 100 HP; the god mode is off (it would gate the hits).
